knowledge.textEn: NuSTAR studies black holes and extreme environments using high-energy X-rays.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 用長焦距光學教學模型換算結構橫向位移成角誤差，規劃熱變形量測。
knowledge.textEn: Convert lateral structural displacement into angular error in a long-focus teaching model and plan thermal-deformation metrology.

knowledge.title: 物理模型與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 小角近似 θ≈Δx/f；結構位移與天球指向要經座標轉換，不能直接混用。
knowledge.textEn: For small angles θ≈Δx/f;structural displacement and sky pointing require coordinate transformation.

quiz.question: 「結構與視線座標」：哪一項指出本課需保留的異常機制或替代解釋，不能直接當成驗收成功？
quiz.questionEn: Structure and sightline frames: Which statement identifies an anomaly mechanism or competing explanation that cannot be treated as successful acceptance?
options: 交付位移角度表、座標定義與補償前後殘差，保留未量測方向。
若像移跟結構溫度週期一致但星追蹤姿態穩定，應查內部相對位移而非只改整星指向。
optionsEn: θ=0.0005/10×206265=10.31325 arcsec for one small-deformation direction.
Deliver shift-angle table,frames and before/after residuals,retaining unmeasured directions.
Image shift correlated with structural temperature but stable tracker attitude suggests internal relative motion rather than whole-spacecraft pointing.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「故障與替代解釋」。若像移跟結構溫度週期一致但星追蹤姿態穩定，應查內部相對位移而非只改整星指向。 與本階段判準一起判讀：相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies fault and competing explanation. Image shift correlated with structural temperature but stable tracker attitude suggests internal relative motion rather than whole-spacecraft pointing. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.

steps.title: 結構與視線座標 · 分辨異常成因
steps.titleEn: Structure and sightline frames · Discriminate anomaly causes
steps.objective: 完成「結構與視線座標」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Structure and sightline frames and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若像移跟結構溫度週期一致但星追蹤姿態穩定，應查內部相對位移而非只改整星指向。
對照「結構與視線座標」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。用獨立結構量測與星像殘差交叉驗證，補償後仍需保留熱遲滯檢查。
本階段必須重驗：相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
steps.instructionEn:
Image shift correlated with structural temperature but stable tracker attitude suggests internal relative motion rather than whole-spacecraft pointing.
Against the nominal Structure and sightline frames result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Cross-check structural metrology and stellar residuals,and test thermal hysteresis after compensation.
Reverify this criterion: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若像移跟結構溫度週期一致但星追蹤姿態穩定，應查內部相對位移而非只改整星指向。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Image shift correlated with structural temperature but stable tracker attitude suggests internal relative motion rather than whole-spacecraft pointing.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
steps.checkEn: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.

quiz.question: 「結構與視線座標」：哪一項提供依證據採取處置或重新驗證的條件？
quiz.questionEn: Structure and sightline frames: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?
options: 小角近似 θ≈Δx/f；結構位移與天球指向要經座標轉換，不能直接混用。
用獨立結構量測與星像殘差交叉驗證，補償後仍需保留熱遲滯檢查。
NuSTAR 以高能 X 射線研究黑洞與極端天體環境。
optionsEn: For small angles θ≈Δx/f;structural displacement and sky pointing require coordinate transformation.
Cross-check structural metrology and stellar residuals,and test thermal hysteresis after compensation.
NuSTAR studies black holes and extreme environments using high-energy X-rays.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。用獨立結構量測與星像殘差交叉驗證，補償後仍需保留熱遲滯檢查。 與本階段判準一起判讀：相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Cross-check structural metrology and stellar residuals,and test thermal hysteresis after compensation. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.

steps.title: 結構與視線座標 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Structure and sightline frames · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「結構與視線座標」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Structure and sightline frames and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付位移角度表、座標定義與補償前後殘差，保留未量測方向。
在交接件中加入「結構與視線座標」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：用長焦距光學教學模型換算結構橫向位移成角誤差，規劃熱變形量測。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver shift-angle table,frames and before/after residuals,retaining unmeasured directions.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Structure and sightline frames: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Convert lateral structural displacement into angular error in a long-focus teaching model and plan thermal-deformation metrology. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
steps.check: 相對位移與整體旋轉分開記錄。
steps.checkEn: Relative shift and whole-body rotation are recorded separately.
